She's always looking for new ways to make abstract concepts tangible and relevant to her students' lives.

messages.output_raw:
I don’t have live or historical airline data access, so I can’t see the exact departure vs. scheduled time for WN512 on 2025-10-12.

Fastest ways for you to check:

1) Southwest’s site/app  
- Go to “Flight status”  
- Enter:  
  - Airline: Southwest  
  - Flight number: 512  
  - Date: Oct 12, 2025  
- It should show: scheduled departure, actual departure, and whether it was “On time,” “Delayed,” or “Cancelled.”

2) Flight-tracking sites  
- Go to FlightAware or FlightRadar24  
- Search: “WN512” and set the date to Oct 12, 2025  
- Look for:  
  - Scheduled departure vs. actual departure  
  - If actual is within ~15 minutes of scheduled, airlines usually count that as “on time.”

If you want, tell me what times it shows for scheduled vs actual departure and I’ll tell you whether that would be considered “on time” or delayed.
